Generated from the model types in [`crates/canon/src/model`](https://github.com/beyond10x/canon/blob/main/crates/canon/src/model). `canon evaluate` reads a compiled protocol, one case snapshot, a set of evidence records and, optionally, a list of explicit decisions, and writes a decision. `canon check` reads a protocol and, optionally, the properties declared beside it. Every key is listed; a key Canon does not know is refused.

## `canon-case/1`

Read by `canon evaluate`. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/case-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types.

### `Case`

A `canon-case/1` case snapshot as written.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | required | The document format; the evaluator accepts only `canon-case/1`. |
| `id` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`CaseId`) | required | — |
| `protocol` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ProtocolId`) | required | The protocol that governs the case. |
| `artifacts` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) to [`CaseArtifact`](#caseartifact) | required | The current revision of each declared artifact, keyed by artifact id. |
| `termination` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`OutcomeId`) | optional | The outcome the case terminated through; absent while the case is open. Whether the protocol declares it is checked by the outcomes section (story:outcomes). |
| `revision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`Revision`) | optional | The case's own current revision. An explicit decision applies only while its `case_revision` is this one; a snapshot without one has no explicit decision applying. |

### `CaseArtifact`

One declared artifact as the case snapshot records it.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `revision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`Revision`) | required | The artifact's current revision. |

## `canon-evidence/1`

Read by `canon evaluate`. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/evidence-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types.

### `EvidenceRecord`

One `canon-evidence/1` record as written. `subject` and `subject_revision` bind it: the
evaluator refuses a record whose subject the protocol does not declare, and applies a record
only while its subject revision is the case's current revision of that subject.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | required | The document format; the evaluator accepts only `canon-evidence/1`. |
| `id` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceId`) | required | — |
| `kind` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceKindId`) | required | The evidence kind, which the protocol declares. |
| `result` | text | optional | What the observation found; a record without one matches only an evidence match that names no result. |
| `subject` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ArtifactId`) | required | The artifact the record is about. |
| `subject_revision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`Revision`) | required | The revision of that artifact the record is about. |
| `observed_at` | [text](#text-formats) (`Instant`) | optional | When the observation was made; its age at the evaluation instant is measured from here. A record without it never expires. |

## `canon-decision/1`

Written by `canon evaluate`.

### `Decision`

A `canon-decision/1` document. A section slot that is `None` is not serialized.

| Key | Value | Present | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | always | Always `canon-decision/1`. |
| `case` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`CaseId`) | always | — |
| `protocol` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ProtocolId`) | always | — |
| `protocol_revision` | integer, 0 or more | always | The revision of the compiled protocol that applied. |
| `claims` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) to [`ClaimDecision`](#claimdecision) | always | Every declared claim, in identifier order. |
| `obligations` | any JSON value | when present | Each declared obligation, `open` or `discharged`, in identifier order; written when the protocol declares an obligation. Its shape is fixed by CANON-OBLIGATION-001. |
| `actions` | any JSON value | when present | Each declared action, `admissible`, `approval-required` or `blocked`, with the reasons for a status other than `admissible`; written when the protocol declares an action. Its shape is fixed by CANON-AUTHORITY-001. |
| `outcomes` | any JSON value | when present | Each declared outcome, `legitimate` or `blocked`, with the reasons it is blocked; written when the protocol declares an outcome. Its shape is fixed by CANON-OUTCOME-001 and, for an outcome that requires an explicit decision, by CANON-OUTCOME-002: a legitimate one records `decided_by` (`{"decision": <name>, "principals": [...]}`), and a blocked one gives the reason `{"decision": <name>, "present": false}`. |
| `explanation` | any JSON value | when present | Why each claim that is not `true`, each open obligation, each action that is not admissible and each blocked outcome has its status, traced to the evidence records that applied or were excluded, and what the decision was computed from (`computed_from`); the evaluator writes it on every decision. Its shape is fixed by CANON-EXPLAIN-001. |

### `ClaimDecision`

One claim's entry in a decision.

| Key | Value | Present | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | [`Truth`](./protocol.md#truth) | always | — |
| `excluded_evidence` | list of [`EvidenceExclusion`](#evidenceexclusion) | when not empty | The evidence an exclusion stage kept from this claim, in evidence-id order. Empty unless a stage excluded something; an empty list is not serialized. |

### `EvidenceExclusion`

One evidence record an exclusion stage kept from a claim, and why.

| Key | Value | Present | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evidence` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`EvidenceId`) | always | — |
| `reason` | [`ExclusionReason`](#exclusionreason) | always | — |

### `ExclusionReason`

Why evidence was excluded before claims were evaluated.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `revision_mismatch` | Bound to a revision of its subject that is not the current one. |
| `expired` | Older than its kind allows at the evaluation instant. |
| `invalidated` | Invalidated by an invalidation rule. |

## `canon-decisions/1`

Read by `canon evaluate --decisions`: a list of `ExplicitDecision` entries; an empty list is allowed, and an entry given twice is refused. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/decisions-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types.

### `ExplicitDecision`

One entry of a `canon-decisions/1` document. It applies to `outcome` when the outcome requires
a decision named `decision` and `case_revision` is the case snapshot's revision.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`DecisionName`) | required | Which decision was taken. |
| `outcome` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`OutcomeId`) | required | The outcome it was taken for. |
| `principal` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`Principal`) | required | Who took it. |
| `case_revision` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`Revision`) | required | The case revision it was taken at. |

## `canon-properties/1`

Read by `canon check --properties`. The [JSON Schema](https://beyond10x.github.io/canon/schemas/properties-1.schema.json) is generated from the same types.

### `Properties`

A `canon-properties/1` document as written.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | text | required | The document format; `canon check` accepts only `canon-properties/1`. |
| `protocol` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ProtocolId`) | required | The id of the protocol the properties are about; `canon check` refuses another. |
| `properties` | map from [identifier](#identifiers) (`PropertyId`) to [`Property`](#property) | optional | The properties, keyed by identifier. A property declared twice is refused. |

### `Property`

One property: its subject's status is the same in every two states that agree on everything
except the evidence the `independent_of` claim reads.

| Key | Value | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | text | optional | — |
| `subject` | [`PropertySubject`](#propertysubject) | required | The action or outcome whose status the property is about. |
| `independent_of` | [`PropertyDependency`](#propertydependency) | required | What the subject's status must not depend on. |

### `PropertySubject`

What a property is about. Written as a map with exactly one of the keys `action` or `outcome`.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ActionId`) | The action's status: `admissible`, `approval-required` or `blocked`. |
| `outcome` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`OutcomeId`) | The outcome's status: `legitimate` or `blocked`. |

### `PropertyDependency`

What a property's subject must not depend on. Written as a map with the one key `claim`.

| Key | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `claim` | [identifier](#identifiers) (`ClaimId`) | The claim, standing for the evidence it reads, by kind and subject, directly or through the claims it tests. |

## Identifiers

An identifier is text. A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). Each kind of identifier is its own type, so one cannot stand in for another. These are the kinds these documents use:

| Type | Identifies |
|---|---|
| `ProtocolId` | Identifies a protocol, independently of its revision. |
| `CaseId` | Identifies one case governed by a protocol. |
| `ArtifactId` | Identifies an artifact a protocol declares. |
| `Revision` | Identifies one revision of an artifact, or of the case itself: the case snapshot's own revision, and the case revision an explicit decision was taken at. |
| `ClaimId` | Identifies a claim a protocol declares. |
| `EvidenceId` | Identifies one evidence record. |
| `EvidenceKindId` | Identifies a kind of evidence a protocol declares. |
| `ActionId` | Identifies an action a protocol declares. |
| `OutcomeId` | Identifies an outcome a protocol declares. |
| `DecisionName` | Names an explicit decision an outcome may require (`explicitly_inconclusive`). |
| `Principal` | Who took an explicit decision, recorded as given: Canon resolves no identity. |
| `PropertyId` | Identifies one property of a `canon-properties/1` document. |

## Text formats

These values are text in a fixed form, not identifiers. Canon refuses text that does not match its pattern, and also checks what the pattern cannot:

| Type | Written as | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `Instant` | An instant written `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` in UTC, whole seconds, uppercase `T` and `Z`, no leap second (`2026-10-04T12:00:00Z`): when evidence was observed, and the evaluation instant. Calendar validity is checked by Canon, not by the pattern: the date must exist (leap years included) and the time be at most 23:59:59. | `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$` |
